cards.text: javac compiles source into {{c1::bytecode}}, which it writes to a .class file. At run time the {{c2::JVM}} loads and executes that file.
cards.extra: javac turns source into platform-neutral bytecode and writes it to .class files; the JVM loads, verifies and runs those files. That indirection is why one build runs on every platform that has a JVM.
cards.example:
javac Hello.java   # writes Hello.class, the bytecode
java Hello         # the JVM loads and executes it
